name: ace
description: Code Engine ACE - Intelligent pattern learning with continuous auto-search. v6.6.4: Bugfix — subagent learning now actually reaches the server (run SubagentStop after_task async in the background). ace_stop_wrapper.sh runs ace_after_task.py ASYNC in the background (ACE_ASYNC_LEARNING=1) so its `ace-cli learn` SSE stream to the server survives after the hook returns. But ace_subagent_stop_wrapper.sh ran after_task SYNCHRONOUSLY (RESULT=$(... python3 ...)), so it was bound by the SubagentStop hook timeout — Claude Code killed ace-cli MID-STREAM before it reached the server, so subagent learning traces never landed. Evidence from session telemetry: of 87 after_tasks that reached the read step (playbook_load logged), only 3 ever completed the learn (all main/Stop); ZERO subagents completed. Fix: add the same ACE_ASYNC_LEARNING background block to ace_subagent_stop_wrapper.sh (write INPUT_JSON to a temp file, launch python3 ace_after_task.py < tmp & detached, drop an in-flight lock, return immediately). Now the subagent `ace-cli learn` finishes talking to the server instead of being killed → subagent ExecutionTraces reach the server → subagent reward/bandit warming finally works end-to-end (completes the v6.6.0/6.6.2/6.6.3 chain). Requires: Claude Code >= 2.1.139, ace-cli >= 3.17.0 (@ace-sdk/core >= 2.19.0).
